description: Extraction contract reference examples demonstrating semantic role assignment, entity disambiguation, modality detection, credential theft isolation, and user correction handling.

examples.scenario: Candidate email appears before recruiter email
examples.key_aspect: Semantic role distinction between candidate destination and corporate sender

examples.scenario: Employer differs from a Google Meet/Microsoft Teams mention
examples.key_aspect: Separation of claimed employer entity from interview software tooling

examples.scenario: No-fee policy plus quoted scam warning
examples.key_aspect: Modality tagging distinguishing active demands from negated policies and quoted advisories

examples.scenario: Explicit fee demand with payment recipient
examples.key_aspect: Structured decomposition of payment demands with recipient identifiers and rails

examples.scenario: Explicit credential demand with secret values omitted
examples.key_aspect: Omission of live secrets and explicit categorization of OTP / password solicitation

examples.scenario: Ambiguous stipend/salary period and an unresolved employer
examples.key_aspect: Handling of unspecified compensation frequency and distinctly attributed user corrections

examples.scenario: Unknown contact role, retained fields and absent employer
examples.key_aspect: Neutral contact does not establish recruiter role; Unicode offsets use code points.
Coordinates and page are unavailable; quote offsets refer only to sanitized OCR text.
